meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.citation: our current fiscal year 2027 plan anticipates about $2.0 billion of awards, compared to $1.6 billion last year.
We now expect FY2027 capital expenditures of between $850 million and $900 million, including approximately $250 to $300 million for Inmarsat related capital expenditures.
For FY2027, we continue to expect operating cash flow to be flat YoY with free cash flow generated now expected to improve to more than $225 million.
